scope: Final provider-free follow-up. Successful and partial campaign outputs use an explicit synthetic oracle transport, not Jev inference.

checks.equivalent_command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=bench/jev python3 -B -m unittest test_adapter test_run test_bridge test_model_resolution test_audit test_complete_audit -v
checks.environment: Cleared inherited environment, only explicit safe paths, Git no-lazy-fetch/noninteractive settings, and known local evaluator binary.
new_checks: Complete exact-model synthetic campaign: 79 evaluations, 66 unique judgments, 68 occurrences, exact mixed label counts.
Mixed acceptance: 68 judged occurrences, 34 accepted, no replacement of abstentions with acceptance.
Complete synthetic alias-policy campaign retains the alias on wire and pins one declared test ID.
Semantic-stop projection preserves the wrong recorded label rather than substituting gold.
Actual adapter crossing at 1,200,000 reported tokens retains usage but excludes the crossing judgment from projection.
Erased, missing, falsy, and malformed transport metrics fail at named checks.
A forged completed over-budget body is rejected before eligibility or alias binding. Exactly 1,000,000 tokens remains eligible.
A real preflight credential-containment failure with zero transport calls needs no fabricated metrics.
Threshold and custody metadata contradictions are rejected.
Historical Git reads receive a minimal environment with lazy fetching disabled.
Impossible first-call or cumulative campaign durations fail before eligibility and alias binding, with per-call rounding tolerance.
Post-final-call bookkeeping duration and conservative duration lower-bound boundary do not cause false rejection.
Requested model grammar is checked even when hashes have been recomputed consistently.
Legacy unresolved alias failures remain replayable but cannot expose retained judgments, with or without new policy metadata.
Conservative JSON structural response-size bounds reject impossible bodies and are checked across Unicode and UTF-8/16/32 encodings.

limitations: Synthetic oracle controls do not establish TypeSafe compatibility, semantic quality, calibration, throughput, billing, or competitive advantage.

Replay checks declared local internal consistency and the default CLI resource envelope. Time and serialized-size lower bounds only reject certain impossible claims. They do not authenticate metrics or reconstruct missing raw bodies and wall-clock gaps.
Historical code hashes are checked, not reexecuted. Legacy unresolved aliases with retained judgments are intentionally unsupported.
No memory relevance experiment or repository auditor has been implemented or evaluated by this claim-support pilot.

memory_boundary_inspection.method: actual Azdaja start/load/exec/final on src/memory/recall.rs, provider /usr/bin/false, followed by targeted source reads
observations: Current recalled candidates require positive word overlap in text/tags before the four-match cut.
Linked disagreement and incoming supersession context is separately prioritized and bounded.
No Jev memory path or memory mutation was added.
